t: Inventory and Orders Log – Reorder Point and Shipping Cost Calculator

A free tool for rebuilding a supplier and product catalog, calculating reorder points, creating purchase orders, allocating shipping costs, and manual inventory with results exported without needing an account or login.
Complete inventory and orders log in the browser

This tool lets you create and manage an inventory and orders catalog entirely in your browser, with no registration or server storage; you can enter data manually or import a CSV file, then calculate the reorder point and suggested quantity based on current stock and expected consumption, and issue purchase orders with partial receipt support and shipping and customs costs allocated to units to determine the actual cost, plus a manual inventory that shows discrepancies and local export of all results as a JSON or CSV file.
Can data be saved between sessions?
No, the app runs entirely in your browser and stores nothing on the server. You can export the data manually and save it on your device.
Does the app support Excel files?
It only supports CSV files for import, and you can convert Excel files to CSV before use.
The "Allocate costs" button adds shipping and customs costs to the unit cost based on the entered values (simple simulation).
The "Manual inventory" button opens an area to record discrepancies, and you can add these values manually in future versions.
Does the app work in all browsers?
Yes, it uses standard JavaScript and does not rely on features unsupported in modern browsers.
